usage: This idiom is used to describe situations where previous efforts or achievements have been completely wasted or rendered useless due to some failure.
It often carries a negative tone, expressing regret or frustration about lost hard work.
You can use it in both formal and informal contexts to emphasize how all prior work has been undone.
In conversation, it is typically used as a predicate or part of a predicate to comment on a particular outcome.
The expression can be applied broadly in various scenarios, such as work, studies, relationships, or projects.

examples.sentence: 我哋咁耐嘅準備都白費咗，真係前功盡廢。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gam3 noi6 ge3 zeon2 bei6 dou1 baak6 fai3 zo2, zan1 hai6 cin4 gung1 zeon6 fai3.
examples.meaning: All our long preparation was wasted; truly an effort wasted.

examples.sentence: 如果呢次唔成功，我之前嘅心機就前功盡廢喇。
examples.jyutping: jyu4 gwo2 ni1 ci3 m4 sing4 gung1, ngo5 zi1 cin4 ge3 sam1 gei1 zau6 cin4 gung1 zeon6 fai3 laa3.
examples.meaning: If this time is not successful, all my prior effort will be wasted.

examples.sentence: 佢嘅錯誤決定，令到整個計劃都前功盡廢。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 ge3 co3 ng6 kyut3 ding6, ling6 dou3 zing2 go3 gai3 waak6 dou1 cin4 gung1 zeon6 fai3.
examples.meaning: His wrong decision caused the entire plan's effort to be wasted.

examples.sentence: 唔好咁快放棄，免得前功盡廢啦！
examples.jyutping: m4 hou2 gam3 faai3 fong3 hei3, min5 dak1 cin4 gung1 zeon6 fai3 laa1!
examples.meaning: Don't give up so quickly, or the effort will be wasted!
